messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: People in Singapore applying for NON-OFFICE roles (for example food service, retail, warehouse, cleaning, security, trades or delivery) who had a job interview in the last 6 months. Interviews may be short, informal, walk-in or a trial shift.
Kind of persona: low_wage_worker (a person in a manual, service or gig role)
Number of personas: 2
Variation axes (spread the set across these): type of work, age band, digital comfort, how much they prepare
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): a research interview about how they prepared for their latest job interview

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "low_wage_worker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content:
{
  "personas": [
    {
      "persona_id": "cafe-jan23",
      "kind": "low_wage_worker",
      "label": "Young barista who relies on phone apps",

      "situation_now": "Just finished a 30‑minute walk‑in interview at a neighbourhood coffee shop and is waiting for a callback.",
      "goals": ["Land a regular shift at a coffee shop", "Earn enough to cover rent and support his sibling's tuition"],
      "constraints": ["Limited cash for transport", "Low confidence in interview etiquette", "Only a basic phone for internet access"],
      "digital_comfort": "medium",
      "reading_style": "Skims headlines, reads bullet points, relies on emoji cues for tone",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Curious but skeptical; thinks AI might help with résumé tweaks",
      "known_gaps": ["How to dress appropriately for a café interview", "What specific barista skills to highlight", "Formal phrasing in thank‑you messages"],
      "biases_or_habits": ["Prefers video clips over text instructions", "Tends to repeat what friends say rather than research himself"],
      "voice": "Casual, uses Singlish slang sparingly, like \"Can, I try my best lah\".",
      "simulation_notes": "Will lose interest if asked to read long policy docs; keep prompts under 2 sentences."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "warehouse-lee",
      "kind": "low_wage_worker",
      "label": "Mid‑30s warehouse worker with low tech exposure",
      "first_name": "Lee",
      "background": "38-year-old male on an S Pass, originally from Malaysia, who has been doing manual loading jobs for a decade. He rarely uses the internet beyond messaging apps.",
      "situation_now": "Completed a brief trial shift at a logistics centre two weeks ago; awaiting feedback on whether to be hired permanently.",
      "goals": ["Secure a stable weekly income", "Maintain steady work to support his family back home"],
      "constraints": ["Limited English reading ability", "No personal computer, only a basic feature phone", "Time spent on commute reduces study time"],
      "digital_comfort": "low",
      "reading_style": "Reads every word slowly, relies on large fonts, gets overwhelmed by dense text",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Unfamiliar; thinks AI is for high‑tech jobs",
      "known_gaps": ["What questions to expect in a warehouse interview", "How to follow up after a trial shift", "Understanding safety certifications required"],
      "biases_or_habits": ["Trusts word‑of‑mouth advice more than online sources", "Avoids anything that looks like a formal questionnaire"],
      "voice": "Direct, uses simple English, e.g., \"I work hard, need steady job\".",
      "simulation_notes": "Will ask for clarification frequently; avoid jargon and keep any instructions visual or numbered."
    }
  ]
}
